description: Test suite for Slack streaming configuration and update functions, including resolving stream modes, applying updates, and building status text.

methods.name: resolveSlackStreamMode
methods.description: Resolves the Slack stream mode, defaulting to 'replace' if input is invalid.

methods.name: resolveSlackStreamingConfig
methods.description: Resolves the Slack streaming configuration, mapping legacy and boolean inputs to unified config object.

methods.name: applyAppendOnlyStreamUpdate
methods.description: Applies an update to a stream, appending or replacing the rendered and source text appropriately.

methods.name: buildStatusFinalPreviewText
methods.description: Generates a cycling status message with dots.
